sentences.text:
Kusum Lata Singh And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
on 31 May, 2024

Author: Rajeev Misra
Bench: Rajeev Misra
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:100395
Court No. - 77
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 11560 of 2023
Applicant :- Kusum Lata Singh And 2 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Gaurav Sharma

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Saroj Kumar Tiwari
Hon'ble Rajeev Misra,J.
1.

Heard Mr. Gaurav Sharma, the learned counsel for applicant and the learned A.G.A. for State,
opposite party-1.
2. Even though the name of Mr. Saroj Kumar Tiwari, is duly published in the cause list as counsel for opposite party-2.
However, neither he nor any one on his behalf has put in appearance to oppose this application.

3. Challenge in this Criminal Misc. Application Under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is to the order dated 20.02.2023 passed by Additional Sessions Jude, Court No.13, Aligarh in Sessions Trial No. 2055 of Kusum Lata Singh And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 31 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73370193/
1 2022 (State Vs. Ravikant and others) under Sections 498A, 307, 323, 327, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Sections 3/4 D. P. Act, Police Station Gandhi Park, District-Aligarh whereby by discharge application filed by applicants under Section 227 Cr.P.C. seeking their discharge in aforementioned sessions case has been rejected by court below.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Jude, Court No.13, Aligarh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. At the very outset, the learned A.G.A. contends that charges have already been framed against present applicants vide framing of charge order dated 16.03.2023.
5. Upon perusal of record, this Court finds that no interim order was granted by this Court in present application.
6. In view of above and also the judgement of Apex Court in Ratilal Bhanji Mithani Vs. State of Maharastra and others, 1979 (2) SCC 179 the question of discharge has now become academic.

entities.text: Ratilal Bhanji Mithani Vs. State of Maharastra and others, 1979 (2) SCC 179
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As such, no effective relief can be granted to the applicant in present application.
7. When confronted with above, the learned counsel for revisionists could not overcome the same.

8. Having heard the learned counsel for revisionists, the learned A.G.A. for State and upon perusal of record this court finds that since charges have been framed against applicants therefore the challenge to the order passed by court below rejecting the prayer for discharge prayed for by applicant has now become infructuous.
9.
In view of above, the present application fails and is liable to be dismissed 10.
